sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF ERN NC
sections.text: ...NRN AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS/NRN PLAINS... A WELL-DEFINED UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH IS FORECAST TO MOVE EWD INTO THE NRN ROCKIES TODAY AS AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE REMAINS IN PLACE ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS. AN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY IS FORECAST TO BE LOCATED FROM THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS EXTENDING NNWWD ACROSS THE WRN HALF OF SD...WRN ND INTO ERN MT. THE MODELS VARY ON WHEN AND HOW FAR EAST CONVECTION WILL INITIATE THIS AFTERNOON. ALTHOUGH ISOLATED STORMS COULD INITIATE IN THE ERN DAKOTAS THIS AFTERNOON...THE CURRENT THINKING IS THAT MOST OF THE CONVECTION WILL BE FOCUSED OVER ERN MT AND THE WRN DAKOTAS ON THE WEST SIDE OF THE LOW-LEVEL JET AXIS. THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD BECOME QUITE NUMEROUS AS THE UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH FINALLY MOVES INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS TONIGHT WITH AN MCS POSSIBLY ORGANIZING IN THE CNTRL AND ERN DAKOTAS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS LATE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS WRN SD LOOK QUITE IMPRESSIVE WITH MUCAPE VALUES OF 3000-4000 J/KG...0-6 KM SHEAR VALUES AROUND 50 KT AND STRONG DIRECTIONAL SHEAR PROFILES BELOW 700 MB. THIS SHOULD FAVOR SUPERCELLS WITH TORNADO POTENTIAL AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING. THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR TORNADOES APP

sections.title: SRN AND CNTRL PLAINS/OZARKS/TN VALLEY
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE IS FORECAST TO BE IN PLACE ACROSS THE SRN HIGH PLAINS TODAY WITH NORTHWEST FLOW EXTENDING SEWD ACROSS THE OZARKS INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY. A COLD FRONT WILL MOVE SWD INTO NRN OK...CNTRL AR AND CNTRL MS THIS AFTERNOON WITH A WELL-DEFINED MOIST AXIS JUST BEHIND THE FRONT. ATTM...MODEL FORECASTS DIFFER ON THE CORRIDOR WITH THE GREATEST THUNDERSTORM POTENTIAL DUE TO THE WEAKLY FORCED ENVIRONMENT. HOWEVER...IT APPEARS THAT AT LEAST ONE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER SHOULD DEVELOP ALONG THE BOUNDARY AND MOVE ESEWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE SLIGHT RISK AREA. SFC DEWPOINTS AROUND 70 F...VERY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND STRONG INSTABILITY WILL LIKELY BE FAVORABLE FOR WIND DAMAGE. THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT COULD PERSIST IF AN BOWING MCS/COLD POOL CAN ORGANIZE DURING THE EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: SRN ATLANTIC COASTAL STATES
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE SLOWLY EWD ACROSS THE NERN STATES TODAY EXTENDING SWD INTO THE CAROLINAS. MODERATE INSTABILITY IS FORECAST ACROSS THE ERN CAROLINAS SOUTH OF A SLOW MOVING COLD FRONT. MODEL FORECASTS ARE IN AGREEMENT INITIATING NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE INSTABILITY AXIS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN ERN NC LATE THIS AFTERNOON SHOW STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...20-25 KT OF LOW-LEVEL FLOW...SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S F AND MODERATE VERTICAL SHEAR. THIS SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL THREAT OR FOR BOWING LINE SEGMENTS. WIND DAMAGE WOULD BE THE MOST LIKELY THREAT. A FEW SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE FURTHER SOUTHWEST ACROSS GA AND SC WHERE STRONG INSTABILITY AND ABUNDANT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WILL BE IN PLACE. HOWEVER...THE POTENTIAL SEVERE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN MARGINAL DUE TO WEAKER VERTICAL SHEAR IN THIS AREA.

sections.title: MAINE
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW WILL MOVE SLOWLY EWD ACROSS QUEBEC TODAY WITH A BROAD UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH EXTENDING SWD INTO THE NERN STATES. THUNDERSTORMS APPEAR LIKELY TO DEVELOP AHEAD OF A MID-LEVEL JET IN NRN NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON DUE TO WARMING SFC TEMPS AND RELATIVELY STRONG LARGE-SCALE ASCENT. IN SPITE OF THE WEAK INSTABILITY...FORECAST SOUNDINGS THIS AFTERNOON SHOW ENOUGH VERTICAL SHEAR COMBINED WITH COLD AIR ALOFT /500 MB TEMPS AROUND -20C/ FOR A HAIL THREAT WITH THE STRONGER CELLS. ..BROYLES/JEWELL.. 07/13/2009

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER CENTRAL/ERN NC
sections.text: ...HIGH PLAINS EWD ACROSS THE NRN/CENTRAL PLAINS... UNSEASONABLY STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH DRIVING EWD INTO THE NRN ROCKIES THIS MORNING WILL SHIFT STRONG MID LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS INTO THE NRN/CENTRAL PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT AHEAD OF IT. ATTENDANT 50-60 KT SWLY MID LEVEL JET WILL LIKEWISE OVERSPREAD THE NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON. THIS WILL OCCUR ATOP TIGHTENING LOW LEVEL GRADIENT BETWEEN APPROACHING COLD FRONT AND STOUT HIGH PRESSURE HOLDING OVER THE UPPER MS RIVER VALLEY/GREAT LAKES...WITH STRONG SELY LLJ DEVELOPING BY LATE IN THE DAY ACROSS THE WRN DAKOTAS. SEVERAL ROUNDS OF SLIGHTLY ELEVATED STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST AND SHIFT ESEWD ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS TODAY AHEAD OF THIS IMPULSE...WITH ISOLATED SEVERE AS DEEP LAYER SHEAR SUPPORTS ORGANIZED ACTIVITY. PRIMARY THREAT IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR IN WAKE OF THIS ACTIVITY OVER PORTIONS OF MT ESEWD INTO THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS LATER TODAY. SETUP WILL BECOME QUITE FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS THIS REGION THROUGH THE EVENING GIVEN INTENSE UPPER SYSTEM AND SUBSTANTIAL SHEAR. ATTM...UNCERTAINTIES REGARDING COVERAGE/INTENSITY OF EARLY DAY STORMS/CLOUDS WARRANTS LEAVING OUTLOOK AS A SLGT. HOWEVER...UPGRADE TO MDT MAY BE NEEDED

sections.title: SRN KS/NRN OK INTO THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: OUTLOOK ACROSS THIS REGION REMAINS QUITE MESSY THIS MORNING WITH EXTENSIVE ACTIVITY PERSISTING FROM THE OZARK PLATEAU SEWD INTO THE CENTRAL AL. THIS SHOULD SUPPORT A SLIGHT SSWWD PUSH TO EFFECTIVE SURFACE COLD FRONT AS COMPARED TO THE PAST FEW DAYS...ALTHOUGH WRN END OVER NWRN OK/SWRN KS MIGHT BE SHIFTED SLIGHTLY NWD ONCE AGAIN BY EXCESSIVE HEATING OVER THE SRN PLAINS. SEVERE THREAT FROM THE MID SOUTH SEWD CAN BE EXPECTED WITH POCKETS OF HEATING INCREASING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AHEAD OF SEMI-ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS SHIFTING SSEWD THROUGH THE DAY. SOME UNCERTAINTY REMAINS REGARDING DIURNAL DEVELOPMENT OVER WRN PORTION OF THIS FRONT...ALTHOUGH HIGH RES AND OPERATIONAL WRF INDICATE AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT COULD DEVELOP BY THE EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: NC
sections.text: WV IMAGERY INDICATES SHORTWAVE TROUGH APPROACHING THE ERN CAROLINAS ALREADY THIS MORNING...SUPPORTING CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE TSTMS ACROSS CENTRAL NC AT DAYBREAK. HEATING THIS MORNING SHOULD BE HINDERED BY EARLY CLOUDS...HOWEVER SUFFICIENT HEATING FOR MODEST SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY SHOULD DEVELOP AND INCREASE THE POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS/HAIL. DEEP LAYER SHEAR FROM 35-45 KT MAY SUSTAIN LINEAR COMPLEX ALREADY UNDERWAY EWD ACROSS ERN NC THROUGH THE EARLY AFTERNOON...WITH POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE AHEAD OF APPROACHING SHORTWAVE TROUGH.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST
sections.text: A FEW SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF GA AND SC WHERE STRONG INSTABILITY AND ABUNDANT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WILL BE IN PLACE AHEAD OF SWD SAGGING SURFACE COLD FRONT. HOWEVER...THE POTENTIAL SEVERE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN MARGINAL DUE TO WEAKER VERTICAL SHEAR IN THIS AREA.

sections.title: ME
sections.text: MOSTLY CLEAR SKIES SHOULD SUPPORT MARGINAL INSTABILITY TODAY UNDER POCKET OF COLD MID LEVEL TEMPERATURES FORECAST TO OVERSPREAD PORTIONS OF ME. SURFACE CONVERGENCE WILL BE WEAK...ALTHOUGH WIDELY SCATTERED LOW-TOPPED TSTM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD OCCUR WITH POTENTIAL FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND STRONG WINDS WITH THE STRONGER CORES. ..EVANS/HURLBUT.. 07/13/2009

sections.title: NRN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/TONIGHT
sections.text: A STRONG MID LEVEL TROUGH OVER ID WILL CONTINUE EWD OVER MT/WY TO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS BY TONIGHT. AN ASSOCIATED SURFACE CYCLONE IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP TODAY INVOF THE MT/WY/SD BORDER INTERSECTION AND THEN PROGRESS EWD NEAR THE SD/ND BORDER THROUGH TONIGHT...WHILE A SURFACE WARM FRONT LIFTS SLOWLY NWD ACROSS SD. THIS CYCLONE...ALONG WITH A TRAILING LEE TROUGH AND THE SURFACE WARM FRONT...WILL PROVIDE A FOCUS FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH TONIGHT. IN THE SHORT TERM...A LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED LOW-LEVEL WAA ARE SUPPORTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF SLIGHTLY ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS FROM SW ND INTO N/NW SD. SOME OF THESE STORMS WILL MAINTAIN SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AND BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. MEANWHILE...BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW-MID 60S ARE RETURNING NWWD ACROSS NEB AND SRN/WRN SD TOWARD SE MT...AND THIS TREND SHOULD CONTINUE IN RESPONSE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SLY LLJ DOWNSTREAM FROM THE EJECTING NRN ROCKIES TROUGH. THIS MOISTURE AND SURFACE HEATING IN THE RELATIVELY NARROW WARM SECTOR...BENEATH STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES...WILL RESULT IN MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 2000 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON FROM WRN NEB INTO WRN SD. SUR

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY TO THE NRN OK/SRN KS AREA THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS ARE MOVING SWD/SEWD ACROSS CENTRAL AL/MS AND ERN AR/NW MS...NEAR AND S OF A STALLED FRONT AND BELT OF NWLY FLOW AROUND THE PERIPHERY OF THE SRN PLAINS MID LEVEL HIGH. STRONG SURFACE HEATING TO THE S/SW OF THE ONGOING STORMS FROM SRN AR INTO LA/MS/SW AL AND AN INFLUX OF LOW 70S BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE VALUES AOA 2000 J/KG...AND THE POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. GIVEN 20-30 KT LOW-MID LEVEL FLOW AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR APPROACHING 30 KT...A FEW ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS WITH DAMAGING OUTFLOW GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS LESS CERTAIN FARTHER NW INTO NRN OK AND SRN KS ALONG THE OUTFLOW REINFORCED FRONTAL ZONE...WHERE THE CAP IS STRONGER IN PROXIMITY TO THE MID LEVEL HIGH OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS. STILL...IF STORMS DEVELOP ALONG THE BOUNDARY AS HOT SURFACE TEMPERATURES ERODE CONVECTIVE INHIBITION...THERE WILL BE SOME THREAT FOR DAMAGING OUTFLOW WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: MAINE AREA THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: AN EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS ROTATING EWD OVER NRN NEW ENGLAND/SRN QUEBEC TOWARD MAINE THIS AFTERNOON. DESPITE RATHER COOL SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND SURFACE DEWPOINTS ONLY IN THE MID 40S TO LOW 50S...COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT WILL RESULT IN SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY FOR STORMS WITH SMALL/MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: ERN NC THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: WIDESPREAD CLOUDS/RAIN ARE ALREADY OVERSPREADING ERN NC IN ADVANCE OF A REMNANT MCV FROM CONVECTION YESTERDAY ACROSS THE LOWER OH AND TN VALLEYS. THIS WILL LIMIT DAYTIME HEATING AND THE MAGNITUDE OF INSTABILITY THIS AFTERNOON...THUS THE THREAT FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS APPEARS TO HAVE DIMINISHED. ..THOMPSON/GARNER/COOK.. 07/13/2009

sections.title: NRN PLAINS AND ROCKIES
sections.text: PREVIOUS FORECAST REASONING APPEARS ON TRACK ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES AND ADJACENT AREAS OF THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. REFER TO LATEST MESOSCALE AND WATCH DISCUSSIONS IN THESE AREAS FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS ON THE DEVELOPING SEVERE WEATHER.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: THE PROSPECTS FOR ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG WEAKLY CONVERGENT OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM THE OZARKS SEWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE DELTA APPEAR LIMITED GIVEN VERY WEAK LARGE SCALE SUPPORT AND ABUNDANT WARM AIR ALOFT. HOWEVER...GIVEN INTENSE SURFACE HEATING WITH TEMPERATURES EXCEEDING 100F IN PARTS OF THE AREA...IT APPEARS THAT CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL DOES EXIST FOR SOME DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS. HAVE ATTEMPTED TO CONFINE THE HIGHER SEVERE WIND PROBABILITIES TO THE CORRIDOR WHERE GREATEST DESTABILIZATION AND WEAK LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE CURRENTLY COEXIST. ..CARBIN.. 07/13/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT MON JUL 13 2009/

sections.title: NRN AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS/NRN PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING FROM ERN MT SEWD ACROSS SD BETWEEN THE AXIS OF AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE IN THE NRN PLAINS AND AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH IN THE NRN ROCKIES. A 50-60 KT MID-LEVEL JET IS CURRENTLY EJECTING ENEWD INTO THE NRN PLAINS AND THIS FEATURE IS CREATING STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION FAVORABLE FOR ROTATING STORMS. IN ADDITION...THE RUC IS ANALYZING AN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY FROM ERN MT SEWD ACROSS WRN AND SRN SD INTO NRN NEB WHERE MLCAPE VALUES RANGE FROM 2000 TO 4000 J/KG. SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS AND SEVERAL LONGER TRACK SUPERCELLS ARE ONGOING ALONG THIS INSTABILITY AXIS. THE GREATEST THREAT FOR TORNADOES SHOULD EXIST IN WRN SD AS THE LOW-LEVEL JET STRENGTHENS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS CREATING INCREASINGLY FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES. VERY LARGE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE DOMINANT SUPERCELLS ACROSS WRN AND SRN SD INTO NRN NEB AHEAD OF THE EJECTING MID-LEVEL JET WHERE MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE STEEP AND THE COMBINATION OF SHEAR AND INSTABILITY IS MAXIMIZED. THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL SHOULD INCREASE SEWD WITH TIME AND MAY AFFECT NE NEB AND POSSIBLY NW IA THIS EVENING. LARGE HAI

sections.title: SW AR/FAR SE OK
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING IN WRN AR ALONG AN AXIS OF STRONG INSTABILITY ANALYZED BY THE RUC. THE ACTIVITY IS LOCATED JUST SOUTHWEST OF A MID-LEVEL JET MAX WHICH IS CREATING ENOUGH VERTICAL SHEAR FOR ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS. STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD SUPPORT A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS WITH THE MORE INTENSE CELLS EARLY THIS EVENING. ..BROYLES.. 07/14/2009
